VALUE In Progress 15 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Interior Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This cultural project in Downtown Cairo was developed for the Institut Francais D'Egypte. BECT provided architecture, landscape and interior design, structural and civil engineering, MEP, project management and site supervision services. The 15 million EGP assignment coordinated the building's multidisciplinary design and implementation requirements.
